status: Accepted originals saved and verified in canonical, local and production; remaining gaps recorded.

accepted.sourceIdentityEvidence: Supplier page and variant code 013020 explicitly identify 300 g/m² photo card in DIN B2, colour rot. The original ATEHNA family identifies unbranded B2/300 g photo card; its named colour and original flat swatch agree with this ordinary colour/finish. No brand or proprietary shade claim is imported. This is commodity matching by material, format, grammage and colour, not proof of a manufacturer identity. B2 is the original named format: the imported 707 mm conversion was generated from B2, not a measurement. The supplier labels DIN B2 (approximately 50×70 cm). Supplier reuses some colour stock-photo compositions between 130 g and 300 g pages; this exact source is attached to its 300 g page and does not independently demonstrate grammage or stiffness. It is one photograph, not a newly invented angle.

additionalRejectedSources.decision: Whole sharp chocolate brown sheets, but visibly deeper/redder than the sold medium brown original swatch; reject shade mismatch.

accepted.sourceIdentityEvidence: Source explicitly sells loose plain white sketch/drawing cartridge paper cut to A4 or A5. ATEHNA risalni-list A5 identifies plain white loose drawing paper and A5 dimensions; its original listing and canonical variant do not state grammage or manufacturer. The complete A5 foreground sheet is suitable under authorized unbranded commodity material/form matching; the rear A4 sheet is partially obscured, so this photograph is not assigned as A4 main. No source-only Stamford brand, 140 g weight or manufacturing claim is added to catalog specifications. This illustrates plain drawing paper material and selected A5 shape, not supplier identity or measurable weight.
accepted.view: Complete A5 drawing sheet on contrasting wooden surface, with an A4 sheet behind
accepted.altText: Risalni list A5 v ospredju na leseni podlagi; zadaj je primer formata A4. Dodatni list, knjige in miza niso vključeni.

review.quality: Unchanged native 3024×3024 real photograph. Entire foreground A5 sheet visible with sharp edges and natural paper texture, contrasting wood background, no humans.
review.limitations: A4 rear sheet is partly covered, so excluded from A4 main assignment. Original catalog weight and supplier are unspecified; no source-only grade/brand claims are added.

products.decision: Accept natural-context complete A5. A4 rear sheet is occluded and is not assigned as a main. Brustro sources rejected: human face on packaging and unsupported brand/package.
New A3 board suppliers advertise 0.6, 0.75 or 1 mm rather than sold 0.8 mm; do not substitute thickness. No verified matching source for five remaining cuts.

additionalRejectedSources.decision: Offered thicknesses 0.5,0.75,1,1.25,1.5,2,2.25,3 mm; none establishes sold 0.7,0.8,1.2 mm cuts.
